caption: Pro: OR, NOT and a property operator in one query.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['search-operators']; document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((el) => el.remove()); p.settings.createdProperty = 'created'; p.settings.modifiedProperty = 'updated'; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('search-operators-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); p.openSearch("tag:#meeting -[status:done] OR [status:active]"); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the results of a query written into the weekly review as a list of links.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['search-operators']; document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((el) => el.remove()); p.settings.createdProperty = 'created'; p.settings.modifiedProperty = 'updated'; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('search-operators-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const v = app.workspace.activeLeaf.view; await v.setState({ ...v.getState(), mode: 'source', source: false }, { history: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const ed = v.editor; ed.setCursor(ed.lastLine(), 0); await p.insertResults('tag:#meeting created:>=2026-09-01 sort:created'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Settings: the created and modified date properties, the result limit, the saved searches (Pro) and what Pro adds.

caption: Regression checks for hard inputs.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['search-operators']; p.pro.signOut(); const m=p.openSearch(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); const q='"He said \\"hello world\\""'; const hits=m.getSuggestions(q); if(!hits.some(x=>x.path.endsWith('/Hard inputs.md'))) throw new Error('Escaped quote did not match'); if(m.getSuggestions('padding created:invalid').length) throw new Error('Invalid date returned results'); if(!m.getSuggestions('/a+b/').some(x=>x.path.endsWith('/Hard inputs.md'))) throw new Error('Literal regex text did not match'); m.inputEl.value=q; m.inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'hard inputs passed'; })()
